scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a city street with pedestrians walking along the sidewalk and a bus driving down the road. The sun is high in the sky, casting long shadows across the ground. There are several buildings lining the street, including a large white building with columns and a smaller red building with a flat roof. A group of people are gathered near the intersection, some sitting on the curb and others standing around talking. The street is paved with gray bricks and has a few trees and bushes along the sidewalk. The sky is blue and clear, with a few wispy clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large white building has a classical style with columns and a pedimented roof. It has three stories and a large window on the top floor. The smaller red building has a flat roof and a simple facade with a few windows. Both buildings appear to be well-maintained and have a mix of modern and traditional architectural styles.
